question: Under what temporal condition is old age and death destroyed by the practice stated?
premises: A practice is done for one year.
When that practice has been done, a condition arises.
Under that condition old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: Agent of practice not specified in this verse
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
